import secrets
import msal


def start_oauth_login(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
        config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}",
        client_credential=config['client_secret'])
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    url = app.get_authorization_request_url(config.get('scopes', ['User.Read']),
        redirect_uri=payload['redirect_uri'], state=state)
    return {'authorization_url': url, 'session_id': state}

import msal

from identity_client import get_identity_client


def handle_oauth_callback(payload):
    app = get_identity_client()
    result = app.acquire_token_by_authorization_code(
        payload['code'],
        scopes=payload.get('scopes', ['User.Read']),
        redirect_uri=payload['redirect_uri'])
    return result

from identity_client import get_identity_client


def fetch_profile_claims(access_token):
    app = get_identity_client()
    result = app.acquire_token_silent(['User.Read'], account=app.get_account(access_token))
    if 'access_token' in result:
        graph_data = requests.get(  # Using Microsoft Graph API
            'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me',
            headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + result['access_token']},
        ).json()
        return graph_data
    return None

import secrets
import msal


def pkce_login(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.PublicClientApplication(
        config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}")
    code_verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    code_challenge = msal.create_code_challenge(code_verifier, method="S256")
    url = app.get_authorization_request_url(
        config.get('scopes', ['User.Read']),
        redirect_uri=payload['redirect_uri'],
        code_challenge=code_challenge,
        code_challenge_method="S256")
    return {'authorization_url': url, 'code_verifier': code_verifier}
